channel.title: Wildcard Watch: Ivanti
channel.description: Exploited vulnerabilities and attacks involving Ivanti, each with its fix status and first step.

item.title: Act now (update): Ivanti Connect Secure: 2 flaws exploited together
item.description:
Ivanti Connect Secure: Authentication bypass · low-privileged account · local access · exploited · check vendor · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Update Ivanti Connect Secure to 25.1.1.3 or later.

Ivanti Connect Secure contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that could allow a local authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527.

High · Check vendor · CVE-2026-111357, CVE-2026-118527

item.title: Patch: Ivanti Connect Secure: Authentication Bypass by Spoofing
item.description:
Ivanti Connect Secure: Authentication bypass · internet-facing · exploited from day 0 · fix: 25.1.3.0, 25.1.3.1, 22.8R2.5

First step: Update Ivanti Connect Secure to the fixed version for your release line (for example 25.1.3.0, 25.1.3.1 or 22.8R2.5).

Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

High · Fix available · CVE-2026-104935
